body.silhouette: sleek, low-slung coupe-like profile with a gently sloping roofline that flows into a subtle rear spoiler
body.front: completely grille-less, smooth body-colored nose with a subtle crease line, ultra-minimal
body.rear: full-width LED light bar connecting two blade-shaped tail lights, small lip spoiler integrated into trunk lid

headlights.shape: narrow horizontal slits that wrap slightly around the fender
headlights.daytime_running_lights: bright white LED strip along the bottom edge of each headlight
headlights.appearance: aggressive yet clean, no excessive chrome or bezels

taillights.style: full-width LED light bar with blade accents
taillights.shape: thin horizontal band spanning the entire rear, red glow

glass.windshield: large panoramic, extends far back over occupants
glass.roof: one-piece glass roof from windshield to rear window, tinted

exterior_color.name: Ultra Red
exterior_color.appearance: deep, multi-coat metallic red with rich depth and subtle orange undertones in direct light

interior.material: white vegan leather with carbon fiber trim
interior.steering_wheel: yoke-style, half-moon shape with no traditional top spoke

accent_dark.name: gloss black
accent_dark.usage: window trim, lower fascia, mirror caps

reference_pose.description: 3/4 front view, car angled ~30 degrees showing front and driver side
reference_pose.camera_elevation: slightly below eye level, giving the car a commanding, heroic presence
reference_pose.camera_distance: medium-close, car fills roughly 60% of the frame width
reference_pose.ground_plane: car sits on ground, subtle shadow beneath

lighting.key_light: large soft light from upper-right, warm white
lighting.rim_light: subtle edge light highlighting the roofline and body curves
lighting.reflections: environmental reflections visible on body panels and glass roof

style.depth_of_field: shallow — sharp car, slightly soft background
style.post_processing: clean, slightly desaturated background to make the car pop

prompt_templates.base_prompt: Commercial automotive photography of a Tesla Model S Plaid in Ultra Red multi-coat. Sleek fastback sedan with completely grille-less front, slim blade LED headlights, panoramic glass roof, 21-inch satin black Arachnid wheels. Low, aggressive stance. No badges or text except the small Tesla wordmark on the rear trunk. Ultra-minimal, premium, futuristic.

style_suffixes.minimal_studio: pure white background, soft even studio lighting, clean product shot
style_suffixes.dark_dramatic: dark moody background, dramatic rim lighting, premium luxury feel
style_suffixes.environmental: on a sweeping mountain road or modern architecture setting, cinematic
style_suffixes.night: night scene, headlights illuminated, wet reflective road surface, neon city glow
